rows.text: 📊 Market Benchmarks & ETFs
Watch SPY versus RSP and IWM for breadth confirmation. Rising yields and weaker equal-weight participation disconfirm a broad rebound. MCHI also faces mainland closure and reopening gaps.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
🏦 Financials
Watch yield-curve changes, funding costs and issuer credit disclosures. A steeper curve can support margins; weak credit demand or rising losses can offset it.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
💻 Information Technology
Watch whether yield relief persists and gains broaden beyond the largest issuers. Higher yields or weak company guidance disconfirm the constructive duration-sensitive scenario.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
🔬 Semiconductors
Watch verified AI demand, shipment and export-policy disclosures, and relative performance versus the broad index. Customer concentration, restrictions and weaker demand are bear triggers.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
🩺 Healthcare
Watch company trial, regulatory and reimbursement announcements. Defensive demand may support relative resilience; adverse trial or coverage decisions override the sector narrative.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
🛒 Consumer Staples

Watch volumes, pricing, input costs and issuer guidance. Stable demand is the bull case; margin compression or trading-down pressure is the bear case. PepsiCo has an upcoming results event that requires rechecking issuer timing.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
🛍️ Consumer Discretionary
Watch employment follow-through, wages and financing conditions. Resilient employment supports spending; weakening demand or higher borrowing costs disconfirms it.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
⚡ Energy

Watch official inventory data, crude prices and issuer supply updates. Higher realized prices can support producers; falling crude and margin pressure disconfirm. Midstream and retail fuel companies have different exposures.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
🚚 Industrials, Transport & Logistics

Watch orders, freight demand and fuel costs. Firm activity supports utilization; weaker volumes and higher input costs undermine it. US industrials and Malaysian logistics are distinct sub-industries.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
🌱 Materials & Plantation

Watch metal and palm-oil prices, industrial demand and issuer operating disclosures. Stronger demand supports pricing; weak volumes or costs rising faster than realized prices disconfirm. Metals and plantations require separate analysis.
Unavailable: scenario watch triggers, no validated forecast
